name: Ghost Writer Exposed
description: Someone's claiming they wrote your best bars. And they have proof.

chapters.title: The Accusation
chapters.description: A writer you worked with years ago just posted screenshots. Texts of you asking for bars. Voice notes of him sending you material. He's saying he wrote 60% of your rounds from your breakout battle. The one everyone quotes.

choices.label: Deny Everything
choices.description: Those screenshots are fake. You never worked with him.

choices.label: Admit Collaboration
choices.description: You worked together, but he was a consultant, not a ghost writer.

choices.label: Come Clean
choices.description: He's right. You used writers. Get ahead of it.

chapters.title: More Receipts
chapters.description: He posted more. PayPal transactions. Voice recordings of you saying 'yo that bar is crazy, I'm using that.' Even battlers who were there are saying they remember him in your camp.

choices.label: Double Down
choices.description: He doctored it all. Stay on message.

choices.label: Change Your Story
choices.description: Okay, you worked together. But it was collaboration, not ghostwriting.

chapters.title: The Narrative Battle
chapters.description: You're calling it 'collaboration' and 'having a camp.' Some battlers are defending you - 'everyone has a camp.' Others are saying there's a difference between sparring and having someone write your rounds.

choices.label: Prove It On Stage
choices.description: Take a battle with no prep. Freestyle. Show you can write.

choices.label: Do the Interview Circuit
choices.description: Go on every podcast. Control the narrative.

chapters.title: The Fallout
chapters.description: You admitted it. Some respect the honesty. Others are stripping your legacy. That breakout battle? Doesn't count anymore according to the culture.

choices.label: Rebuild From Scratch
choices.description: Start fresh. Every bar from now on is 100% you.

choices.label: Defend the Practice
choices.description: Drake uses writers. Kanye uses writers. Why is battle rap different?

chapters.title: The Debate
chapters.description: The culture is debating where the line is. Camp help vs ghostwriting. What counts as 'your' material? Some are using you as the example of what NOT to do.

choices.label: Let It Die Down
choices.description: Stop talking about it. Let time heal.

choices.label: Battle Your Accuser
choices.description: If he's such a great writer, let him rap his own bars.

chapters.title: The Freestyle Test
chapters.description: You agreed to a mostly freestyle battle. Limited prep. The world is watching to see if you can actually write.

choices.label: Pure Freestyle
choices.description: No writtens at all. Prove beyond any doubt.

choices.label: 48-Hour Prep
choices.description: Short prep window. Still impressive if you deliver.

chapters.title: The Comeback
chapters.description: You've been writing everything yourself. It's harder. Takes longer. But when you deliver, everyone knows it's you.

choices.label: Big Stage Comeback
choices.description: Go straight to a major battle. Prove yourself where it counts.

chapters.title: Writer vs Rapper
chapters.description: The battle is set. You vs the guy who claims he wrote your bars. Winner settles the debate forever.

choices.label: Body Him
choices.description: This is personal. Leave no doubt.

choices.label: Win Respectfully
choices.description: Beat him but acknowledge his contribution.

endings.title: Proved Them Wrong
endings.description: You went pure freestyle and killed it. Nobody can ever question your pen again. The ghostwriter accusations die here.

endings.title: Vindicated
endings.description: Came back with all original material on the big stage. Delivered. The culture accepted your redemption.

endings.title: Settled the Score
endings.description: You bodied your accuser in a battle. 3-0 clear. He's not talking anymore. The narrative shifted back in your favor.

endings.title: Redeemed
endings.description: Short prep, great performance. Not total proof but enough. Most people moved on.

endings.title: Closure
endings.description: Beat him but acknowledged you worked together in the past. Both moved on. Drama over.

endings.title: Survived
endings.description: Interview circuit worked. Narrative is muddied. Not cleared, not convicted. Just... moved on.

endings.title: Honest Career
endings.description: You write everything yourself now. It's slower progress but it's real. Respect is being rebuilt.

endings.title: Tainted Legacy
endings.description: The accusations never fully went away. Every time you deliver fire, someone in the comments asks who really wrote it.

endings.title: Industry Plant
endings.description: You defended ghostwriting as normal. Some agreed. But battle rap isn't the music industry. You're viewed differently now.

endings.title: Disgraced
endings.description: Denied it until the evidence was undeniable. Lied to everyone's face. Your credibility is gone. Every bar you ever spit is questioned.
